Brother Khatul

Biography

Brother Khatul leads the brotherhood of the Last Shelter, calling himself first among equals. He initially tests Zak by demanding the Emperor’s Signet Ring, wary of spies who could betray the refuge. Once Zak is accepted, Khatul offers a home and support but insists that personal revenge must not expose the entire brotherhood. He arranges training with Brother Blind and asks Brother Faceless to help Zak reach the Portal. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
